query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Razorpay on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Razorpay Briefing: Meeting on 17 November 2026

*Research window: 16 October to 15 November 2026. Prepared 15 November 2026.*

Only one item in the window could be dated and tied to a linkable source. Items just outside the window are labelled as background. Items without a usable date or URL are listed under "Excluded" so they can be verified before the meeting.

## 1. News

- **Final IFSCA Payment Service Provider licence for GIFT City (3 Nov 2026).** Razorpay received its final PSP licence from the International Financial Services Centres Authority, following in-principle approval in April 2026. The licence lets Razorpay move money in and out of India under one framework for global investing, international collections, settlements and multi-currency flows. Razorpay says platform integration time falls from months to 2–3 weeks. Source: [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)

## 2. Product and Service Launches

- **In window:** No launch with a dated, linkable source was confirmed. The GIFT City release says key investment platforms are expected to go live soon.
- **Background (just before window):** ChatGPT Ads through Razorpay Engage (5 Oct 2026). Engage prepares catalogues and runs campaigns with an AI agent and human oversight. Early brands include Tanishq, Titan, Traya, Tata Neu and Axis Max Life. The product is marked "Early access," with no pricing disclosed. Sources: [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom); [Engage ChatGPT Ads page](https://razorpay.com/engage/chatgpt-ads)
- **Background (just before window):** Apple Pay live online and in-store with no card entry or OTP, used by Zepto, Ixigo, IndiGo, Tata 1mg and JioMart (30 Sep 2026). Source: [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)

## 3. Executive and Team Hires or Departures

- **In window:** No hire or departure with a dated, linkable source was found.
- **Leadership note:** Khilan Haria was announced as Chief Product Officer, with a remit covering global product strategy, UPI, POS and Southeast Asia expansion. The Instagram post is undated in the captured text. The newsroom places the elevation on 11 Feb 2025, which conflicts with the LinkedIn profile showing the CPO role from Oct 2024. Source: [Razorpay Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DF7UyTsSvU2?hl=en)

## 4. Deals, Partnerships and Funding

- **Banking integrations:** RBL Bank and ICICI Bank integrations are live for the GIFT City infrastructure, with further banks to follow (3 Nov 2026). Source: [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)
- **Funding, tender offers, acquisitions and new bank agreements:** None with a dated, linkable source was found in the window.

## Excluded (Unverified or Outside Window)

- **Reported SEBI approval for an IPO**, with a listing targeted as early as Q1 2027 and a valuation near USD 5 billion (The Paypers, 5 Nov 2026). No URL was captured. **Verify before the meeting.**
- **Replit partnership** (UPI and card payments for Replit subscriptions, live in beta). No publication date was confirmed.
- **AI and engineering hires** (Sudhir Reddy, Abhishek Agarwal, Bhavya Shivaprakash, Anuj Mathur), reported in August 2026. No linkable source was captured, and Mathur's LinkedIn shows his role from July 2026.
- **Mrityunjoy Das** (Director, Domestic Payments, since July 2025) and **Praveen Parihar** (CISO, September 2025). Both are outside the window.

## Three Open Questions for Razorpay

1. The GIFT City release says platforms can go live in 2–3 weeks, with RBL and ICICI already live. Which investment platforms go live first, which banks join next, and on what timeline?
2. ChatGPT Ads through Engage entered early access in October. What adoption or performance results has Razorpay seen so far, and when will Engage move beyond early access?
3. The CPO's remit includes Southeast Asia expansion. What is the timeline for that expansion, and which products are planned for launch there first?
